events.name: Indiana Pacers at New York Knicks

headlines.description: — When the Indiana Pacers compiled one of the best offensive seasons in NBA history, they were just getting warmed up.
headlines.shortLinkText: Pacers set NBA playoff shooting mark, top Knicks 130-109 in Game 7 to make Eastern Conference finals

headlines.description: — Anthony Edwards overcame a slow start and the Timberwolves roared back from a 20-point second-half deficit to eliminate the reigning NBA champion Denver Nuggets 98-90 in a Game 7 Minnesota masterpiece on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Edwards leads Wolves back from 20-point deficit for 98-90 win over defending NBA champion Nuggets
